title: Gross Domestic Product
text: GDP measures total value of goods and services produced within a country.

title: Inflation rate
text: Percentage increase in general price levels over time, measured by CPI or similar indexes.

title: Deflation
text: Sustained decrease in general price levels. Can harm economic growth.

title: Monetary policy
text: Central bank actions controlling money supply and interest rates to influence economy.

title: Fiscal policy
text: Government decisions on spending and taxation to influence the economy.

title: Interest rates
text: Cost of borrowing money, set partly by central banks. Affects bonds, loans, and stocks.

title: Yield curve
text: Graph showing bond yields by maturity. Inversions often signal recessions.

title: Quantitative easing
text: Central bank buys securities to inject liquidity and lower rates.

title: Economic cycle
text: Phases: expansion, peak, contraction, and recovery.

title: Recession
text: A significant decline in economic activity across the economy lasting months.

title: Depression
text: Extended, severe recession with high unemployment and low output.

title: Unemployment rate
text: Percentage of the labor force without jobs but seeking work.

title: Consumer confidence index
text: Survey measuring how optimistic consumers feel about the economy.

title: Producer price index
text: Tracks changes in prices that producers receive for goods and services.

title: Balance of trade
text: Difference between exports and imports of goods and services.

title: Current account
text: Broad measure of trade plus income and transfers between countries.

title: Exchange rate
text: Price of one currency in terms of another. Influences imports and exports.

title: Currency appreciation
text: When a currency strengthens relative to others.

title: Currency depreciation
text: When a currency weakens relative to others.

title: Trade deficit
text: When imports exceed exports, creating negative balance of trade.

title: Trade surplus
text: When exports exceed imports, creating positive balance of trade.

title: Commodities market
text: Market for physical goods like oil, gold, and wheat. Prices driven by supply and demand.
Energy costs affect inflation, transport, and industrial profits.

title: Gold as safe haven
text: Investors often buy gold during uncertainty to preserve value.

title: Hedge funds
text: Investment partnerships using advanced strategies for higher returns.

title: Mutual funds
text: Pooled investments managed by professionals, priced once daily.

title: Exchange-traded note
text: Unsecured debt instrument tracking an index or asset.

title: Private equity
text: Investments in private companies seeking growth or restructuring.

title: Venture capital
text: Financing for startups in exchange for equity. High risk, high potential return.

title: Sovereign wealth fund
text: State-owned investment fund managing national reserves.

title: Index rebalancing
text: Adjusting index holdings periodically to maintain weighting rules.

title: Stock split
text: Company increases share count while lowering price proportionally.

title: Reverse stock split
text: Company reduces share count to raise price per share.

title: Share buyback
text: Company repurchases its own stock to reduce float and raise EPS.

title: Initial coin offering
text: Crypto fundraising event where investors receive new tokens.

title: Stablecoins
text: Cryptocurrencies pegged to stable assets like the US dollar.

title: Blockchain
text: Distributed ledger technology underpinning cryptocurrencies.

title: Smart contracts
text: Self-executing contracts coded on blockchains with set conditions.

title: DeFi (Decentralized Finance)
text: Financial systems built on blockchain removing intermediaries.

title: NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens)
text: Unique blockchain assets representing digital collectibles or art.

title: Market orders
text: Execute immediately at best available price.

title: Limit orders
text: Execute only at a specified price or better.

title: Stop orders
text: Trigger market order when price reaches specified level.

title: Slippage
text: Difference between expected and actual trade price in fast markets.

title: Margin call
text: Broker demands more funds when equity falls below requirement.

title: Leverage ratio
text: Amount of borrowed funds relative to equity. Increases both gains and losses.

title: Liquidity provider
text: Entity offering buy/sell quotes to keep markets fluid.

title: Market maker
text: Firm or individual maintaining bid and ask prices for liquidity.

title: Algorithmic trading
text: Computerized execution of trades using pre-set rules.
